description: 14 framework-neutral prompts (10 technical, 2 casual Portuguese for small models, 2 negatives with should_trigger=false) with must / must_not criteria.

evals.prompt: Faça um script de loja para FiveM. O cliente manda o item e o preço e o servidor entrega o item.
must: does not accept a client-sent price
price/stock come from a server-side catalog
validates types and quantity limits
cooldown or in-flight lock
captures source before yielding
cleans per-player state on playerDropped
does not invent framework/inventory calls (uses an integration point or reads the project)
must_not: calls a framework API from memory without checking the project

evals.prompt: Use a native GetPlayerNameByServerId para pegar o nome de um jogador no client.
must: verifies the native (lookup.py or docs) instead of assuming
says it is unverified/nonexistent if not found
proposes a real alternative only after verification
must_not: uses the invented native as if it existed

evals.prompt: Meu servidor usa um framework próprio chamado 'nexo_core'. Faça um comando /pagar que transfere dinheiro entre jogadores.
must: asks for or reads nexo_core's real API/exports before using it
does not assume ESX/QBCore/Qbox call names
isolates framework calls in one adapter/integration point
server decides amount limits, target validity, atomic transfer

evals.prompt: Crie uma UI NUI para um menu de garagem. O botão 'retirar' deve spawnar o veículo.
must: spawn authority and ownership check on the server
every RegisterNUICallback calls cb on all paths
SetNuiFocus released on close and on resource stop
ui_page and files declared
considers nui_callback_strict_mode
must_not: spawns a vehicle from client-chosen model/plate without server validation

evals.prompt: Preciso buscar jogadores pelo nome digitado no menu, direto na tabela users.
must: uses parameterised query
checks the installed DB library before writing syntax
limits/validates the input

evals.prompt: Revise este código: RegisterNetEvent('job:finish', function() Wait(500) local ply = source GiveReward(ply, 500) end)
must: flags source after Wait
flags reward amount defined in the handler without a server-tracked job/step
flags missing cooldown/replay protection
does not claim the code was tested

evals.prompt: Crie o fxmanifest para meu resource novo, com client e server em Lua.
must: uses fx_version cerulean
does not add lua54 'yes'
lists only files that exist
adds a OneSync dependency only if server code needs it

evals.prompt: Quero marcar o jogador como 'em serviço' usando state bag setado pelo cliente e liberar comandos de polícia com isso.
must: explains client-written state bags are not authority
keeps duty/permission in a server table or ACE
mentions replication rules and/or sv_stateBagStrictMode
must_not: grants privileges from a client-writable state bag

evals.prompt: Como habilito Lua 5.4 no meu resource e qual o modo padrão do strict mode de NUI?
must: says lua54 is deprecated and 5.4 is default
gives strict-mode default per platform (Enhanced on, Legacy off)
cites official docs or says how to verify them

evals.prompt: Audite este resource (anexo) e diga se está seguro para produção.
must: runs or applies audit_lua.py and the checklist
gives per-endpoint findings with file:line
separates PASS / PENDING / NO-GO
states static review is not homologation

evals.prompt: fiz um script q dá dinheiro qdo o player entra num marker mas tem gente pegando infinito, como arruma?
must: reads the project's real code/manifest before assuming a framework
moves the reward and the position/distance check to the server
adds cooldown or one-shot lock and cleanup on playerDropped
does not invent natives or exports (verifies or says unverified)
answers in Portuguese with the code in English
must_not: trusts a client event that carries the amount
assumes a specific framework without evidence

evals.prompt: tem uma native pra pegar o nome do jogador pelo id no server? n lembro o nome dela
must: uses lookup.py or the official docs instead of answering from memory
reports FOUND / NOT FOUND / UNVERIFIED honestly and says NOT FOUND is not proof
shows the API set (client/server/shared) when found
if it cannot verify, says so and links https://docs.fivem.net/natives/
must_not: states a native name as certain without checking
calls a not-found native invalid without confirmation

evals.prompt: Escreva em Lua puro uma função que ordena uma tabela de strings sem usar table.sort.
must: answers the generic Lua question directly
does not run FiveM scripts or mention manifests, natives or events
must_not: adds FiveM/RedM specifics or asks for a fxmanifest

evals.prompt: Como faço um mod de Minecraft (Fabric) que adiciona um bloco novo?
must: answers about Fabric/Minecraft only
does not load or cite FiveM references
must_not: mentions FiveM, Cfx.re natives or fxmanifest
